title: Sulfur Metabolism in Yeast: Met17 and Hsu1's Role
summary: This cluster revolves around the sulfur metabolism in yeast, specifically focusing on the genes Met17 and Hsu1. Met17 is involved in catalyzing homocysteine and has activity in sulfate. Hsu1 has a pleiotropic role in sulfate and is expressed in met17Δ mutants. The deletion of Hsu1 results in hsu1Δ, which exhibits no consistent fitness defect in sulfur starvation. The accumulation of hydrogen sulfide is mediated by met17 deletion, and sulfate can grow on met17 mutants. The sulfur metabolism is vital to all organisms, and the cluster highlights the importance of Met17 and Hsu1 in this process.
